title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཝ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 99)
shelf_note: Authentic canonical Tibetan Buddhist scholastic treatise from the Madhyamaka section (volume Wa / 99) of the Derge Tengyur, containing Avalokitavrata's commentary on Bhāviveka's Prajñāpradīpa.

ocr_errors.problem: redundant syllable པ་ inserted in the lemma citation

tr_errors_B.english: syllogistic statement made by the Madhyamaka practitioner who asserts...
tr_errors_B.problem: omits explicit mention of the three components of the formal syllogism (thesis, logical reason, and example)

tr_errors_B.english: position previously refuted by the Madhyamaka
tr_errors_B.problem: translates future passive participle སུན་དབྱུང་བའི་ ('to be refuted') as past tense ('previously refuted')

pages.prefer_reason: Translation A captures the folio continuation markers seamlessly, accurately translates grammatical aspects of the debate terminology, and fully conveys all formal syllogistic components.

book_verdict: Clear woodblock print folio of the Derge Tengyur with a highly accurate transcription and excellent scholarly translation in Version A.
